description:
# Niconico YT Integration Test 1.49.0-niconico.4

Personal test build in david419kr's fork. No upstream PR has been opened.

## Change
- Rename the patch to **Niconico-style live/replay comments**, removing the Experimental suffix.
- Keep the implementation, opt-in default, settings, and declared YouTube targets unchanged from .3.
- Test build .3 was reported working on a phone with YouTube 21.23.492. This naming change does not add device stress-test coverage.

## Validation
- Local unit checks and Android bundle packaging succeeded.
- All 107 selected patches, including the renamed Niconico patch, applied to the original Google-signed YouTube 21.23.492 APK; APK rebuilding succeeded with no failures.
- The clean PR-preparation branch has no personal distribution changes and merges without conflicts with upstream dev at e32b05c66.

Declared Niconico compatibility remains YouTube 21.20.405 and 21.23.492. YouTube 21.20.405 has PC patch/rebuild evidence; 21.23.492 also has user-reported device evidence. 21.04.223 has not been added.

## 폰에서 업데이트
1. **Sources → Niconico YT Integration Test → Update**에서 **1.49.0-niconico.4**를 확인합니다.
2. 기존 원격 주소는 그대로입니다: `https://github.com/david419kr/morphe-patches`.
3. 패치 선택 화면에서 **Niconico-style live/replay comments**를 선택합니다. 이름이 바뀌었으므로 기존 선택이 이어지는지 확인합니다.
4. 원본 **21.23.492 APK**에 권장 패치와 니코니코 패치를 적용하고 설치합니다.

Private, members-only, age-restricted, and other chat requiring sign-in is unsupported. Long-running busy-chat/emoji stress behavior is not separately verified.

The standalone 1.3.3 source remains unchanged. No upstream pull request has been created.
